originalTitle: Semi-transparent, colored cadmium telluride photovoltaic panels in agrivoltaics
content: See-through solar cells harvest some wavelengths of light to make electricity, while passing through the red and blue wavelengths that plants need. In a new agrivoltaics experiment, broccoli yields held steady.
